title: Tree Challenge
description: A simple datapack that only allows you to walk on wooden or semi-wooden block (and blocks that required for beating the game)
body:
A simple datapack that only allows you to walk on wooden or semi-wooden block (and blocks that required for beating the game)
Allowed blocks that are not connected with wood:
•Water
•Air
•Portal(Nether and End)
•End Portal Frame
•Obsidian(for end platform and nether portal)
